defs.def: （表示迟疑或两个可能性之间的选择）是否

ex.s: Whether or not we pay attention to the world’s “scentscape”, heat and pollution are causing it to shift.
ex.t: 无论我们是否关注世界的“气味景观”，高温和污染都在使它发生变化。

ex.s: He discovered that whether someone describes having had some control over events in their past is an important predictor of a person’s mental health.
ex.t: 他发现，一个人是否描述自己过去对事件有过某种掌控感，是预测其心理健康的重要指标。

ex.s: Prof Gracie, with all his patience, asked me to think about it beyond whether I liked it or not.
ex.t: 格雷西教授以他全部的耐心，让我去想它，别只管我喜欢不喜欢。

ex.s: Before choosing to study online, consider whether you’re a self-motivated learner and if the material seems interesting enough to keep you going.
ex.t: 在选择在线学习之前，要考虑自己是否是一个有自学动力的人，以及学习材料是否足够有趣能让你坚持下去。

ex.s: We will probably never know whether it’s true.
ex.t: 我们可能永远无法知道这是否是真的。

ex.s: C stop arguing whether the universe is a simulation
ex.t: C 停止争论宇宙是否是一个模拟。

ex.s: Whether facts speak louder than words.
ex.t: 事实是否胜于雄辩。

ex.s: This is how a piece of art makes you feel, and whether or not you appreciate or enjoy that feeling.
ex.t: 这是一件艺术品带给你的感受，以及你是否欣赏或享受那种感觉。

ex.s: People develop countless habits as they explore the world, whether they are aware of them or not.
ex.t: 人们在探索世界的过程中养成无数的习惯，无论他们是否意识到这一点。

ex.s: The technology could determine whether a driver had just texted, emailed or done anything else that is not allowed under New York's hands-free driving laws.
ex.t: 该技术能判断司机是否刚刚发过短信、邮件或做了纽约免提驾驶法所不允许的其他事情。

ex.s: Whether a driver used their phone.
ex.t: 司机是否使用他们的电话。

ex.s: Whether they are smarter than monkeys.
ex.t: 它们是否比猴子聪明。

ex.s: Whether they use a sense of touch in the test
ex.t: 它们在测试中是否使用了触觉

ex.s: Whether you ride a bicycle, you don’t use petrol.
ex.t: 无论你是否骑自行车，你都不用汽油。

ex.s: 一I haven’t made up my mind whether I’ll sign the contract with this company.
ex.t: —我还没决定是否要与这家公司签合同。

ex.s: A computer system will analyze the video to determine whether a cow is sick.
ex.t: 一个计算机系统将分析视频，判断一头牛是否生病。

ex.s: That way, cattlemen will know whether they need to move their cattle to another field for nutrition purposes.
ex.t: 这样，牧场主就能知道是否需要把牛赶到另一块草地以获取营养。

ex.s: Multiple genes behaved differently, depending on whether someone had eaten or not before walking.
ex.t: 多个基因的表现因人是否在步行前进食而有所不同。

ex.s: The second drawer began to fill and as it did I wondered whether there were bigger discoveries out there, not just species, but life that depends on things thought to be useless, life even without DNA.
ex.t: 第二个抽屉开始装满，就在它装满时我想知道外面是否还有更大的发现，不只是物种，还有依赖被认为无用的东西生存的生命，甚至没有DNA的生命。

ex.s: He's still hesitating about whether to take the job.
ex.t: 他仍在犹豫要不要接受这份工作。

ex.s: Thus, the keyboard can determine people's identities, and by extension, whether they should be given access to the computer it's connected to—regardless of whether someone gets the password right.
ex.t: 因此，键盘可以确定人们的身份，进而判断是否应允许他们使用与其连接的电脑——无论某人是否输入了正确的密码。

ex.s: Soon you will also question whether the voice you're hearing is actually real.
ex.t: 机器人电话的问题已经变得如此严重，以至于许多人现在拒绝接听来自陌生号码的电话。

ex.s: He is most probably checking whether everything is OK.
ex.t: 他很可能在更换灯泡。

ex.s: When I started running in my 30s, I realized running was a battle against myself, not about competition or whether or not I was athletic.
ex.t: 在我30多岁开始跑步时，我意识到跑步是一场与自己的较量，而不是关乎竞争或我是否有运动天赋。

ex.s: The Yellowstone wolf project has been a valuable experiment to help biologists decide whether to reintroduce wolves to other parts of the country as well.
ex.t: 黄石狼项目是一项有价值的实验，有助于生物学家决定是否将狼重新引入该国其他地区。

ex.s: You ask your customer whether he/she needs a doggie bag.
ex.t: 你询问顾客是否需要打包袋。

ex.s: If you ever get the impression that your dog can "tell" whether you look content or annoyed, you may be onto something.
ex.t: 如果你得到的印象是 你的狗可以"说" 无论你看起来满足或烦恼, 你可能会在的东西。

defs.def: （表示两种情况都真实）是 …（还是），或者 …（或者），不管 …（还是）

ex.s: Make sure that any abbreviations and emojis you use are appropriate for the situation, and consider whether your readers will even know what you mean by BRB or COZ.
ex.t: 请确保您使用的任何缩写和表情符号都适合这种情况，并考虑您的读者是否会知道您所说的BRB或COZ是什么意思。

ex.s: I really did not know whether I should continue correcting him or simply drop the matter.
ex.t: 我真的不知道是该继续纠正他还是干脆放弃这件事。

ex.s: Is comprehension the same whether a person reads a text onscreen or on paper?
ex.t: 一个人在屏幕上读文章和在纸上读文章，理解效果是一样的吗？

ex.s: The project results from the difficulties many schools have in getting artists of any sort - whether an up-and-coming local musician or a major movie star - into schools to work with and inspire children.
ex.t: 该项目源于许多学校在邀请任何类型的艺术家——无论是崭露头角的本地音乐人还是大牌电影明星——进入学校与儿童合作并启发他们时所面临的困难。

ex.s: But if he's out there every day and playing hard, you should praise his effort regardless of whether his team wins or loses.
ex.t: 但如果他每天都在那里努力打球，无论他的球队输赢，你都应该赞扬他的努力。

ex.s: All participants were then tested on how they process information, and whether it's in a more practical or abstract way.
ex.t: 然后所有参与者都接受了测试，看他们如何处理信息，是以更实用还是更抽象的方式。

ex.s: “Everyone can play a part in reducing waste, whether by not purchasing more food than necessary in your weekly shopping or by asking restaurants to not include the side dish you won’t eat,” Curtin says.
ex.t: “每个人都可以在减少浪费方面发挥作用，无论是在每周购物时不买超过需要的食物，还是要求餐厅不要上你不吃的配菜，”Curtin说。

ex.s: “We can’t seem to make up our minds whether we want a modern city or a traditional one.
ex.t: 我们似乎拿不定主意，到底是想要一座现代城市还是传统城市。

ex.s: Whether you’re looking at wallpaper or paint, the time, effort and relative expense put into it are significant.
ex.t: 无论你是看壁纸还是油漆，投入的时间、精力和相对成本都是相当可观的。

ex.s: I hadn’t, until one day my five-year-old son asked me whether there was ham in a hamburger.
ex.t: 我一直没想过，直到有一天我五岁的儿子问我汉堡里有没有火腿。

ex.s: Speakers will state whether they are for or against the statement.
ex.t: 发言者将说明他们是赞成还是反对该声明。

ex.s: I hadn't, until one day my five-year-old son asked me whether there was ham in a hamburger.
ex.t: 我一直没想过，直到有一天我五岁的儿子问我汉堡里有没有火腿。
